records.claim: Olanzapine passes into breast milk in small amounts. Side effects were not reported in most infants exposed to olanzapine through breast milk. In one study, symptoms such as irritability, tremors, being more sleepy than usual, having trouble sleeping or staying asleep were reported in a small number of infants. If you suspect the baby has any symptoms (irritability, tremors, or having any sleep problems), contact the child’s healthcare provider. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
